what: When the hand rests on a header menu item for .12s (immediately if one is already open), the panel below opens from height 0 to its own height in .35s power3.out while the backdrop fades in over .3s, and the cells inside the panel float up from 8px below after .1s over .3s power3.out (all staggered within .25s). When the hand leaves for more than .15s, the cells go off by moving 4px up over .14s and the panel closes in .25s power2.in. Once closed, the cells return to their place (0). It also closes with Esc, a press on the backdrop, or a press outside the panel, and on desktop it ignores item presses (as in the original) — touch devices open it with a press.

options.enter: Delay from hover to open (ms), default 120
options.leave: Time from releasing to closing (ms), default 150
options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Opening item — pick the panel by data-key (multiple)
options.[data-fx-part=box]: Box with a panel that changes height

use: One

from.where: shared.js initNav .co-drop — original mega-nav (hover 120ms · leave 150ms · overlay .3 power2.out · panel height .35 power3.out · [data-menu-fade] y 8 .3 stagger amount .25 · close .14 power2.in / .25 power2.in / overlay .2)

note: On touch devices it opens on tap instead of hover. While open, data-open is attached to the element
